title: Hatchspire
about: Hatch and raise tower-born monsters. Rebuild your camp beneath the ruined spire, breed stronger companions, and push ever deeper into the dungeon above.
This catalog build is an internal development preview, not the approved public demo.

controls.desc: Every required action has a visible target
D-pad or stick selects; A activates; B goes back; LB/RB selects tower actions
Tap New Game, Continue, Settings, or Save Options
Tap camp actions, buildings, NPCs, or Enter Tower
Tap the labeled cards and action buttons
Tap a room to focus it, then tap ROUTE
Tap EXPLORE, SURVEY, CAMP, RETREAT, or FIELD GUIDE
Tap ATTACK, SKILL, DEFEND, HERBS, or FLEE
Tap Save, Load, Title, or Exit Game
Optional shortcuts supplement the same visible controls
